layers.prompt: Use case: illustration-story background plate. Asset type: wide landscape establishing illustration for Starsector Marines, a grounded mercenary ground-operations game; it becomes the background layer of a banner across the top of the company's headquarters screen. Figures are separate layers painted later, so this plate contains NO people at all: no crew, no silhouettes, no figures in the distance, no reflections of people. Style: detailed late-1990s/early-2000s science-fiction strategy-game illustration, matte-painted cinematic industrial realism, visible restrained brush texture, the same painted family as the game's character portraits. Tactile worn metal, scuffed deck plate, cable runs, patched paint. Restrained olive, charcoal, umber and cream palette. Lighting, which the figure layers will match: warm amber key light from below and in front, coming from console screens and the chart table; soft cool blue-grey fill from a long viewport on the back wall; dim ceiling. Scene: the operations deck of a converted ex-freighter that a mercenary marine company lives aboard. Not a gleaming warship bridge: low ceiling, exposed ribs and conduit, hand-labelled panels with no legible text, a coffee mug and clipped paper on a corkboard. Camera: eye level, slightly elevated, looking straight across the deck at the back wall; flat frontal perspective, horizon at mid-height, so later figure layers can stand on the deck at consistent scale. A long viewport along the back wall shows a dark starfield and the edge of a dusty planet. Stations, left to right, separated by open deck so each reads as a distinct place: (1) far left to about a quarter of the width, a comms bank of two chunky seated console stations with empty swivel chairs turned slightly toward each other, banks of small amber screens and patch cables; (2) from about a third to just past half the width, a large backlit chart table lit from below with a warm paper-like glow, waist height, with clear empty deck in front of it (near side) and behind it (far side) where people will stand; (3) from about two thirds to five sixths of the width, a logistics and ledger station: a standing desk with stacked manifests, a small screen of columns, and a supply crate beside it, with empty floor in front for a person to lean on the desk; (4) at the far right, an open bulkhead hatch with a ladder going down and a crew roster board beside it covered in small name tags. All stations and the chart table sit inside the middle 60% of the frame height; the top 20% is plain ceiling and lights, the bottom 20% is plain deck. Keep the lower-right of the middle band visually quiet and dark. Live effects will be drawn over this plate in the game, so paint every console screen as a simple front-facing rectangle with a dim, even amber glow and only faint texture (no painted readouts, graphs or maps on them), and paint the chart table top as a flat, evenly lit warm surface seen at a shallow angle with nothing drawn on it; small indicator lamps may be painted unlit. Constraints: no people of any kind, no text, lettering, numbers, logos, insignia, HUD elements, frames or watermark. No holograms, no blue neon, no floating screens, no weapons, no giant mechs, no huge spaceships in the viewport. Opaque, edge-to-edge painting.

layers.prompt: Full-length standing figure card of Castle for a layered illustration, to be placed into the operations-deck painting given as the style reference. She is the same person as the identity reference: a woman in her early fifties, warm pale olive skin, lived-in face with fine expression lines, steady grey-green eyes, dark brown hair with silver at the temples tied back in a short practical bun, worn charcoal-olive high-collared duty jacket over a faded undershirt, dark work trousers and boots, small earpiece with a short boom microphone. Pose: standing upright, relaxed, body in three-quarter view turned slightly toward the viewer's left, face toward the viewer with a restrained knowing half-smile, holding a battered data slate low in one hand. Whole body in frame from top of head to boots, natural adult proportions, small clearance around the figure. Viewpoint matches the deck painting: seen from a camera slightly above her head height, tilted down about 15 degrees, at a few metres' distance. Lighting matches the style reference: warm amber key light from below and in front (a glowing chart table she stands behind), soft cool blue-grey rim light from a viewport behind her. Same matte-painted style and brushwork. True transparent background, including negative spaces; no ground, floor, cast shadow slab, table, border, text or other people.
